column1: # Book 4 review (Fable, 2026-10-30). No fidelity findings. principia = beginnings enforced at 4.667 and 4.699 (register). 4.776 particulae = tiny parts ("particles" barred). 4.619-620, 4.633, 4.684-685 shortened to the band.

column2: if someone should start to squeeze it in the hand and dry it.
Then all we press out is spread through the palate's passages
Now, so we may see why one food suits some, another others,
the positions of the beginnings are changed;
So one scent given to some, another to others, leads each
to its own pasture, and makes it spring back from foul poison,
beginnings than voice, since through walls of stone
the abundance of tiny parts, that it can supply them. {{NOTE: particulae, Lucretius's diminutive, used here only; the tiny parts are the images themselves, not the first-beginnings}}
